title: Paloma and the Smile
author: Isandro Montrose
blurb: Freya Galloway, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
